_about: Bonnie's radio (YouTube) registry. One entry per playlist or channel. Only entries with approvedByDad true AND a passed age check are ever loaded; everything else is ignored when the page is regenerated (python3 _generator.py). No YouTube Data API key is used anywhere: a channel plays through its uploads playlist (UU + the channel id without its leading UC). Never guess an id: copy it from the real playlist or channel page. See README.md. One registry for the whole site: the home-page radio and the Music Playground both read it (via stations.js). Genre tags (flavour, bpm, key_root, mode) are typical values the Playground band follows, not measured from any track. The 'reading' genre feeds the Playground's Reading music button.
